description: A Hand Embroiderer and/or an Addawala embroiders decorative designs as per the tracings or customer requirements on fabric and other materials by hand, using needle and thread. The hand embroiderer uses a variety of sewing techniques to create different kinds of embroidery stitches and effects such as Cross stitch, French knot stitch, Bullion knot stitch, Shade work, Applique work, English Smocking etc. The job requires the hand embroiderer to have the skills to stitch a variety of stitches with precision and accuracy to obtain the desired look.
awardingBodyName: Apparel Madeups and Home Furnishings Sector Skill Council
